layout_summary: A full-bleed, symmetrically centered first-person gaming photograph stacked vertically in three focal tiers: a glowing red neon sign on the upper dark wall, a large flat-screen TV in the center displaying a warm sunset palace scene, and hands holding a white game controller in the foreground.

alignment_axes: Neon sign, TV screen, in-game character silhouette, and handheld controller share a vertical center axis at x=50%
whitespace: 7% dark wall margin above the neon sign (y=0% to y=7%)
10.5% dark wall gap separating the neon sign from the top bezel of the TV (y=13.5% to y=24%)
3.5% dark gap between the bottom of the TV and top of the controller (y=53% to y=56.5%)

scene.subject: First-person view of a player's hands wearing metal-link watches holding a white dual-stick gamepad with a built-in mini display, facing a large flat-screen television on a media console in a dimly lit living room; both screens show a silhouetted figure walking toward a grand domed palace at sunset.
scene.composition: Strict central symmetry along x=50%; foreground arms enter from bottom corners (y=75% to 100%) framing the controller at y=56.5% to 78%, mid-ground TV spans x=16% to 89.5%, y=24% to 53%, flanked by blurred framed wall art and shelves.
scene.camera: Eye-level first-person POV, wide-to-normal lens (~35mm), shallow depth of field keeping the controller sharp while softening the TV and background room.
scene.lighting: Dim ambient room lit by red neon overhead spill, warm orange-gold glow from the TV screen, and cool cyan-blue rim light hitting the left hand and controller.
negative_space: Upper dark wall area surrounding the neon sign (x=15%, y=0%, w=70%, h=23%)

ornaments.description: Red neon tube outer glow and double-ringed stylized second 'C' letterform in the wall-mounted neon sign

why_it_works: Strong central vertical axis aligns the neon sign, palace dome, silhouette, and controller for immediate visual lock.
High-contrast color temperature split (red neon top, warm amber TV center, cool cyan rim-lit hands) separates depth planes clearly.
Mirroring the sunset palace scene on both the TV and the controller's mini-screen reinforces the immersive gaming focal point.
